senses.gloss: चक्र- + आयुध चक्र- + आयुध, m. a name of Viṣṇu, Rām. 6, 102, 12.
चक्र- + आह्वा चक्र- + आह्वा, m. the ruddy goose, Anas casarca Gm., Kathās. 14, 62.
चक्र- + ईश्वर चक्र- + ईश्वर, m. a name of Viṣṇu, Rājat. 4, 276.
चक्र- + गोप्तृ चक्र- + गोप्तृ, m. du. Two men who take care of the wheels of a chariot, MBh. 7, 1627.
चक्षुस्- + ग्रहण चक्षुस्- + ग्रहण, n. weakness of the eyes, Suśr. 2, 267, 21.

चक् चक्, i. 1, Par., Ātm.
 1. † To be satisfied.
 2. † To resist.
 3. To shine. चकित,
 1. Frightened, Bhartṛ. 3, 10.
 2. Timid, Bhāg. P. 5, 8, 18. n. Being frightened, Mṛcch. 86, 20.
 --With the prep. उद् उद्, To see, Bhāg. P. 6, 16, 48.
 --With प्र प्र, प्रचकित, Frightened, Pañc. i. d. 420.
† चक्क् चक्क्, i. 10, Par. To give pain.
चकास् चकास् (cf. काश्), ii. 2, Par. To shine, Bhāg. P. 5, 24, 9 (with श् instead of स्, Bhāg. P. 3, 19, 14).
चकोर चकोर, m. The Greek partridge. Perdix rufa, MBh. 3, 936.
चक्नस चक्नस, Lass. 4, 17, is to be changed to चक्र-सं (कुलम्)

चक्र चक्र,
 I. n.
 1. A wheel, Man. 8, 291.
 2. A potter's wheel, Yājñ. 3, 146.
 3. A discus, or sharp circular missile weapon, especially of Viṣṇu, Rām. 1, 29, 6.
 4. An oil-press, Man. 4, 84.
 5. A circle, Rājat. 5, 230.
 6. A form of military array, a circular position.
 7. An astrological or mystical figure, Rājat. 5, 55 (मातृ-).
 8. A multitude, Rām. 6, 75, 39.
 9. An army, MBh. 5, 1939.
 10. Dominion, Bhāg. P. 9, 20, 32.
 II. m.
 1. The ruddy goose, Anas casarca, MBh. 9, 443.
 2. The name of a people, MBh. 6, 352.
 3. A proper name, MBh. 1, 2147.
 4. The name of a mountain, Bhāg. P. 5, 20, 15.
 --Comp.
चाक्र चाक्र, i. e. चक्र + अ, adj. Performed with a discus, Hariv. 5648.

चक्रक चक्र + क, m.
 1. A kind of snake, Suśr. 2, 265, 17.
 2. A proper name, MBh. 13, 253.

चक्रधर चक्र-धर,
 I. adj.
 1. Bearing a wheel, Pañc. 242, 15.
 2. Bearing a discus.
 II. m.
 1. A name of Viṣṇu (wielding the discus) Mṛcch. 76, 13.
 2. A sovereign, MBh. 3, 8221.
 3. A snake, Rājat. 1, 261.

चक्रबाल चक्र-बाल, and चक्रवाल चक्र-वाल (cf. वालक, A finger ring).
 I. (m. or n.) A ring, MBh. 1, 7021.
 II. m. A range of mountains supposed to encircle the earth, and to be the limit of light and darkness.
 III. n.
 1. A circle, Bhāg. P. 5, 18, 14.
 2. A group, Bhartṛ. 2, 65.
 --Comp.
चक्रवर्तिता चक्रवर्तिता, and चक्रवर्तित्व चक्रवर्तित्व, i. e. चक्र-रर्तिन् + ता, f., or + त्व, n. Sovereign dominion, Daśak. 185, ult.; Hariv. 8815.

चक्रवाक चक्रवाक, i. e. चक्र (based on an imitative sound) -वच् + अ,
 I. m. The ruddy goose, Anas casarca Gm., Rām. 3, 20, 20.
 II. f. की, Its female, Megh. 81.
चक्रवाकिन् चक्रवाकिन्, i. e. चक्रवाक + इन्, [] adj., f. नी, Crowded with ruddy geese, Ragh. 15, 30.
चक्रवाल चक्रवाल, see चक्रबाल.
चक्राङ्किता चक्राङ्किता, i. e. चक्र-अङ्किता (vb. अङ्क्), f. The name of a plant (?), Pañc. 157, 23.
चक्राङ्ग चक्राङ्ग, i. e. चक्र-अङ्ग, m. A goose, MBh. 8, 1895; Man. 5, 12.

चक्रिका चक्रिका, i. e. चक्र + क, f.
 1. A troop, Rājat. 4, 376.
 2. Artifice, Rājat. 5, 279.

चाक्रिक चाक्रिक, i. e. चक्र + इक, m.
 1. An oil grinder, Rājat. 6, 272 (at the same time, A partisan).
 2. A bellman, Hariv. 9047.
 3. A partisan, Rājat. 5, 267.

चक्रिन् चक्रिन्, i. e. चक्र + इन्,
 I. adj. Driving in a carriage, Man. 2, 138.
 II. m.
 1. A name of Viṣṇu, Bhag. 11, 17.
 2. A name of Śiva, MBh. 13, 745.
 3. An oil-grinder, Yājñ. 1, 141.

चक्ष् चक्ष् (akin to अक्षि), ii. 2, Ātm. (in epic poetry also Par., MBh. 3, 601),
 1. To see, Bhāg. P. 5, 7, 13.
 2. To perceive, Bhāg. P. 1, 18, 25.
 3. To say, MBh. 8, 3384 (Par.).
 --With the prep. अभि अभि,
 1. To look at, Chr. 294, 9 = Rigv. i. 92, 9 (अभिचक्ष्या, absol. with lengthened final); Bhāg. P. 4, 8, 18.
 2. To address, Bhāg. P. 3, 13, 5.
 3. To name, Bhāg. P. 3, 12, 51.
 --With आ आ,
 1. To declare, Man. 4, 81.
 2. To address, Daśak. in Chr. 189, 2.
 3. To name, Bhāg. P. 5, 22, 6.
 --With अभ्या अभि-आ,
 1. To look at, Bhāg. P. 1, 9, 11.
 2. To speak, Bhāg. P. 8, 5, 14.
 --With प्रत्या प्रति-आ,
 1. To decline, MBh. 12, 6676.
 2. To repulse, Daśak. in Chr. 181, 6.
 3. To answer (with acc. of the person), Bhāg. P. 3, 15, 11.
 --With समा सम्-आ, To report, Bhāg. P. 1, 4, 13.
 --With परि परि, []
 1. To overlook, Bhāg. P. 4, 14, 33.
 2. To report, MBh. 1, 1025.
 3. To mention, admit, MBh. 12, 294.
 4. To call, Man. 2, 171.
 5. To answer (with acc.), Bhāg. P. 1, 17, 21.
 --With प्र प्र,
 1. To report, MBh. 1, 8331.
 2. To declare, Man. 4, 102.
 3. To call, Man. 2, 59.
 --With संप्र सम्-प्र, To explain, Suśr. 1, 37, 13.
 --With प्रति प्रति,
 1. To perceive, Bhāg. P. 3, 9, 32.
 2. To expect, Bhāg. P. 9, 4, 41.
 --With वि वि,
 1. To see clearly, Bhāg. P. 3, 11, 17.
 2. To explain, MBh. 1, 2199.
 --With प्रवि प्र-वि, To call, MBh. 12, 11466.
 --With सम् सम्,
 1. To look at, Bhāg. P. 3, 19, 8.
 2. To consider, Rām. 2, 1, 27.
 3. To report, MBh. 6, 253.
 --Cf. παπταίνω (properly a denominative of a lost noun, *παπταν = ved. चक्षन्), also ὀπιπτεύω, ὀπίπης; probably Goth. saihvan; A.S. sean; Goth. siuns (for organ. sihvni + s); O.H.G. sagên; A.S. saegan, etc.

चक्षस् चक्ष् + अस्, n. The eye, Chr. 295, 11 = Rigv. i. 92, 11.
 2. Guidance, Chr. 293, 5 = Rigv. i. 87, 5.
 --Comp.
ऽचक्षुष -चक्षुष, i. e. चक्षुस् + अ, A substitute for चक्षुस्, when latter part of a comp. adj., e. g. स-, adj. Seeing, MBh. 1, 6818.

चाक्षुष चाक्षुष, i. e. चक्षुस् + अ,
 I. adj., f. षी.
 1. Peculiar to the eye, e. g. षी विद्या, The magic faculty of seeing every object, MBh. 1, 6478.
 2. Perceptible by the eye, Suśr. 1, 153, 5.
 3. Referring to Manu Cākṣuṣa, Bhāg. P. 4, 30, 49.
 II. m. The name of the sixth Manu, Man. 1, 62.
चक्षुष्मत्ता चक्षुष्मत्ता, i. e. चक्षुष्मन्त् + ता, f. The faculty of seeing, Ragh. 4, 13.

चक्षुष्मन्त् चक्षुष्मन्त्, i. e. चक्षुस् + मन्त्, adj., f. मती.
 1. Seeing, MBh. 1, 737.
 2. Having eyes, Bhāg. P. 3, 23, 19.

चक्षुष्य चक्षुष्य, i. e. चक्षुस् + य, adj., f. या.
 1. Fit for the eyes, [] MBh. 13, 3423.
 2. Agreeable to the eyes, Rājat. 3, 493.

चक्षुस् चक्ष् + उस्, n. The eye, Indr. 4, 1.
 --Comp.
चक्र- + नाभि चक्र- + नाभि, f. the nave of a wheel, Suśr. 1, 354, 7.
चक्र- + नायक चक्र- + नायक, m. the chief of a division of an army, Rājat. 2, 106.
चक्र- + पाणि चक्र- + पाणि, m. a name of Viṣṇu (holding a discus in one hand).
गोपाल-, चक्र-, शूर- + मठ गोपाल-, चक्र-, शूर- + मठ, m. colleges called ‘that of गोपाल’ ‘that of चक्र (-वर्मन्),’ ‘of शूर,’ Rājat. 5, 243; 403; 39.
चक्र-मुषल चक्र-मुषल, adj. performed with the disk and club, Hariv. 5346.
चक्र- + मौलि चक्र- + मौलि, m. the name of a Rākṣasa, Rām. 6, 69, 14.
चक्र- + रक्ष चक्र- + रक्ष, m. two men who take care of the wheels of a chariot, MBh. 1, 5467.
चक्र- + वर्तिन् चक्र- + वर्तिन्, m., f. इनी, 1. a sovereign of the world, MBh. 12, 808. 2. a sovereign, Kathās. 1, 13.
चक्षुर्विषय चक्षुर्विषय, i. e. चक्षुस्-, m. sight, Man. 2, 298.
चक्र- + वृद्धि चक्र- + वृद्धि, f. 1. interest agreed on the risk of safe carriage, Man. 8, 156. 2. interest upon interest, Man. 8, 153.
चक्र- + व्यूह चक्र- + व्यूह, m. the array in a circle, ib. 7, 1441.
चक्षुःश्रवस् चक्षुःश्रवस्, i. e. चक्षुस्-, m. a snake, MBh. 12, 13803.
चक्षुःश्रुति छक्षुःश्रुति, i. e. चक्षुस्-, m. a snake, Rājat. 5, 1.
